{{short description|French mathematician}}
[[File:Leotaud_-_Examen_circuli_quadraturae,_1654_-_857988.jpg|thumb|''Examen circuli quadraturae'' (1654)]]

'''Vincent Léotaud''' (1595–1672) was a French [[Society of Jesus|Jesuit]] [[mathematician]].<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/cb10031420r|title=Léotaud, Vincent (1595-1672)|publisher=[[Bibliothèque nationale de France]]|language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://data.cerl.org/thesaurus/cnp01303893|title=Léotaud, Vincent|publisher=[[Consortium of European Research Libraries]]}}</ref>

In his work ''Examen circuli quadraturae'' he affirmed the impossibility of [[squaring the circle]], against the opinion of [[Grégoire de Saint-Vincent]].<ref>{{Cite book|title=The Oxford Handbook of the History of Mathematics|editor-first1=Eleanor|editor-last1=Robson|editor-first2=Jacqueline|editor-last2=Stedall|publisher=Oxford University Press|date=2009|page=554|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=xZMSDAAAQBAJ&pg=PA554|isbn=9780199213122}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|title=The Oxford Handbook of the Jesuits|editor-first1=Ines G.|editor-last1=Zupanov|publisher=Oxford University Press|date=2019|page=650|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=HAuXDwAAQBAJ&pg=PA650|isbn=9780190639631}}</ref>
